body.name: Mixed-support atlas handle
body.construction: Construct \(\mathscr A\) by enumerating labeled support faces; use oriented segment boxes on rank-two cells, projective endpoint transfers on distinct-endpoint rank-one cells, bounded split vectors on equal-endpoint cells, and the residual-ratio forest on design-B charts; glue component target values and lift any disagreement to full SCMs. All symbolic arithmetic is over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\).
